austintress: They issued Dorian Austintress a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a key to a house that is no longer there in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Dorian Austintress was number 11. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
The new duty roster listed Dorian Austintress as a chaplain. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.
Clear night. Dorian Austintress counted stars until a flare went up and drowned them all.
Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal and Dorian Austintress made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it with frozen hands.

Dorian Austintress lent Marek Ditrih a pencil. The returned pencil came wrapped in a scrap of paper marked 'One good turn'. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Dorian Austintress looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
coreyjmcmichael: Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a bullet that missed him and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich answered the first call, number 23 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
deadeyesimulacrum: The new rifleman gave his name as Tobias Deadeyesimul. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Volunteer number 12. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Tobias Deadeyesimul's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'

Tobias Deadeyesimul found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F13, Tobias Deadeyesimul listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
hodnepijumaloctu: Nobody asked Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal why he came. Nobody in R-F12 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
On sentry duty Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal kept the tin.

Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal and Dorian Austintress made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it with frozen hands. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
